about_the_game:
Overview
Chop Chop: Together is a 2-4 player co-op action and profession simulation game where you’ll experience chaotic and fun moments with your friends, working together or competing against each other! Complete tasks in different professions with your housemates and push the limits of teamwork and competition as you race against time.

Catch fresh fish on fishing boats, dry them, and process them for the perfect delivery.

Package and prepare orders in warehouses, making sure to deliver the right products on time!

Compete with your friends in competitive modes and fight for the highest score.

Unlock new professions, increase difficulty levels, and master your skills.

Release your emotions with tasks that combine teamwork and rivalry on every level; whether you become the best team or sabotage each other! Chop Chop: Together is ready to provide an unforgettable 2-4 player experience with your friends.

short_description: Chop Chop: Together is a chaotic 2-4 player co-op action game where you and your friends take on various professions! Catch fish, package orders, or fight fires. Earn money to customize your home and characters. Work together or compete to become the employee of the month!
